explanations: bucketOf returns 0..99, so a user is in an N% rollout when their bucket is below N. With `<=`, bucket 0 is enabled at 0% (about 1 in 100 users) and every rollout reaches one extra bucket: 1% enables 2%, 25% enables 26%. Only 100% happens to be right. Using `<` makes 0% mean nobody and N% mean N buckets.
